103:3.text: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.

104:1.text: Woe to every scorner and mocker

104:3.text: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.

104:4.text: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.

104:5.text: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?

104:6.text: It is the fire of Allāh,

104:7.text: Which mounts directed at the hearts.

104:8.text: will be closed down upon them

105:1.text: , how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?

105:2.text: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?

105:3.text: And He sent against them birds in flocks,

105:4.text: Striking them with stones of hard clay,

105:5.text: And He made them like eaten straw.
